title: AI disrupts tech business models with high operational costs and #openai #aimodels #techdisruption
description: AI broke the traditional software business model by turning every user interaction into a costly event. Unlike software like Microsoft Excel, which generates revenue with minimal marginal costs, AI services require continuous energy consumption, making each query expensive to serve. This shift challenges the scalability that made tech companies extremely valuable and introduces a fundamental question about AI’s profitability. AI companies face the dilemma of absorbing losses per interaction while aiming to grow by increasing usage, a model more akin to a restaurant that loses money on every dish but hopes volume will turn a profit. Understanding this broken model is crucial for investors, businesses, and users as the AI industry navigates sustainability and trust issues amidst rapid innovation and adoption. #AIbusinessmodel #ArtificialIntelligence #TechInnovation #AIcosts #SoftwareEconomics #MicrosoftExcel #AIprofitability #FutureofTech #AIEconomics #TechIndustry #Sustainability #DigitalTransformation #AIchallenge #TechMarketShift #AIusageCosts
